pages.text: Put a $(item)Water Tower$() beside the track (up to three blocks away; its spout faces the track). It holds 256 buckets: fill it with buckets of water, or pipes.$(br2)Any tank engine or tender in a train standing beside it is filled, its spout swinging down over the track. A timetabled train at a station there waits until it's full.

The marks on its gauge show how full it is, a comparator reads it, redstone holds the spout up, and clicking it says how much it holds. An empty bucket draws water from it.$(br2)A server can turn water off ($(l:more/settings)settings$(/l)).
